text: The initiative is strategically anchored in national programs, enhancing prospects for research continuity and impact scaling. It emphasizes the urgency of practical adaptation solutions due to the breach of the 1.5°C threshold. The call encourages proposals in four comprehensive subtopics while allowing flexibility for high-impact deviations. Governance and accountability are ensured through eligibility criteria and adherence to A*STAR's terms and conditions. Administrative clarity is provided with explicit guidelines for applicants.

metadata.solution_name: China–Singapore Joint Call for Proposals on “Climate Resilience & Adaptation” (2025)
